# php-sql-postgresql-conversions-dtos

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: plain entities, repositories with their own SQL through PDO and services, in PHP 8.4. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: postgresql.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return DTOs (readonly classes); updates take a Patch per field: absent, or a value that may be null.
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/Database.php             the PDO connection to DATABASE_URL
src/Sql.php                  how the repositories run SQL: values and refusals
src/UnitOfWork.php           the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/Errors/                  NotFoundException, ConflictException, ValidationFailedException: no HTTP codes
src/Entities/                one entity per table
src/Repositories/            the repositories of each table
src/Services/                one service per table
tests/                       repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json           what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
composer install
TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgresql://app:app@localhost:5432/app" vendor/bin/phpunit   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

{
    /** @param list<T> $items */
    public function __construct(public array $items, public int $total, public int $offset, public int $limit)

    }

    /**
     * The same page with every row turned into something else.

    public function map(callable $mapper): self

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Common;

/**
 * A field of an update: absent (it keeps its value), or present with a value, which may be null.
 *
 * @template T
 */
final readonly class Patch
{
    /** An absent field; use Patch::of() for one with a value. */
    public function __construct(public bool $isPresent = false, public mixed $value = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * The field keeps its value.
     *
     * @return Patch<mixed>
     */
    public static function absent(): self
    {
        return new self();
    }

    /**
     * The field takes this value, which may be null.
     *
     * @template V
     * @param V $value
     * @return Patch<V>
     */
    public static function of(mixed $value): self
    {
        return new self(true, $value);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Conversions;

use App\ApplicationModels\Product as ProductModel;
use App\ApplicationModels\ProductStatus;
use App\Dtos\ProductCreate;
use App\Dtos\ProductRead;
use App\Errors\NotFoundException;
use App\UnitOfWork;

/** Conversions between the application models and the "products" table: what the service takes and returns. */
final class ProductConversions
{
    /** A Product as the products table takes it. */
    public static function productModelToProductCreate(ProductModel $model, UnitOfWork $uow): ProductCreate
    {
        $category = $uow->categories->findByName($model->categoryName)
            ?? throw new NotFoundException('Category', $model->categoryName);
        return new ProductCreate(
            categoryId: $category->id,
            name: $model->name,
            price: $model->price,
            status: match ($model->status) { ProductStatus::Draft => 'draft', ProductStatus::Live => 'live' },
        );
    }

    /** A row of the products table as a Product. */
    public static function productReadToProductModel(ProductRead $row, UnitOfWork $uow): ProductModel
    {
        $category = $uow->categories->findById($row->categoryId);
        $model = new ProductModel();
        $model->id = $row->id;
        $model->name = $row->name;
        $model->price = $row->price;
        $model->status = match ($row->status) { 'draft' => ProductStatus::Draft, 'live' => ProductStatus::Live, default => throw new \ValueError('No ProductStatus for this value') };
        $model->categoryName = $category?->name;
        $model->tagIds = array_map(fn ($item) => $item->tagId, $uow->productTags->listByProductId($row->id));
        return $model;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use PDO;

/** The database DATABASE_URL names, through PDO. */
final class Database
{
    public const DEFAULT_URL = 'postgresql://app:app@localhost:5432/app';

    /** The URL of DATABASE_URL, or the default one. */
    public static function url(): string
    {
        $url = getenv('DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : self::DEFAULT_URL;
    }

    /** A connection to the database at $url (DATABASE_URL when null). */
    public static function open(?string $url = null): PDO
    {
        $url ??= self::url();
        $parts = parse_url($url);
        if ($parts === false || !isset($parts['host'], $parts['path'])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('The URL of the database is not valid');
        }
        $dsn = sprintf('pgsql:host=%s;port=%d;dbname=%s', $parts['host'], $parts['port'] ?? 5432, ltrim($parts['path'], '/'));
        return new PDO($dsn, rawurldecode($parts['user'] ?? ''), rawurldecode($parts['pass'] ?? ''), [
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
            PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_NUM,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Repositories;

use App\Common\Page;
use App\Entities\Category;

/** Keeps categories rows in memory, for tests and for trying the services without a database. */
final class MemoryCategoryRepository implements CategoryRepository
{
    /** @var array<string, Category> */
    private array $rows = [];

    private int $nextId = 1;

    /**
     * The key of a row, as a list of its key values.
     *
     * @return list<mixed>
     */
    private static function keyOf(Category $row): array
    {
        return [$row->id];
    }

    private static function keyText(Category $row): string
    {
        return serialize(array_map(fn (mixed $value) => $value instanceof \DateTimeInterface ? $value->format('Y-m-d H:i:s.u P') : $value, self::keyOf($row)));
    }

    /**
     * The rows reads can see, by primary key.
     *
     * @return list<Category>
     */
    private function visible(): array
    {
        $rows = array_values(array_filter($this->rows, fn (Category $row) => true));
        usort($rows, fn (Category $a, Category $b) => self::keyOf($a) <=> self::keyOf($b));
        return $rows;
    }

    public function findById(int $id): ?Category
    {
        foreach ($this->visible() as $row) {
            if ($row->id == $id) {
                return $row;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function list(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        $rows = $this->visible();
        return new Page(array_slice($rows, $offset, $limit), count($rows), $offset, $limit);
    }

    public function findByName(string $name): ?Category
    {
        foreach ($this->visible() as $row) {
            if ($row->name == $name) {
                return $row;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function insert(Category $entity): Category
    {
        if ($entity->id === null) {
            $entity->id = $this->nextId++;
        }
        $this->rows[self::keyText($entity)] = $entity;
        return $entity;
    }

    public function update(Category $entity): Category
    {
        $this->rows[self::keyText($entity)] = $entity;
        return $entity;
    }

    public function delete(Category $entity): void
    {
        unset($this->rows[self::keyText($entity)]);
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services;

use App\Common\Page;

use App\UnitOfWork;

/** Operations on tags. Each write runs in its own transaction. */
final class TagService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly UnitOfWork $uow)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Checks the values against the rules of the "tags" table, and the rows they point to; throws ValidationFailedException with every problem.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function validate(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Tag $current): void
    {
        $creating = $current === null;
        $errors = [];
        $value = $values['label'] ?? null;
        if ($value === null) {
            if ($creating || array_key_exists('label', $values)) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('label', 'is required');
            }
        } else {
            if (is_string($value) && mb_strlen($value) > 30) {
                $errors[] = new FieldError('label', 'is longer than 30 characters');
            }
        }
        if ($errors !== []) {
            throw new ValidationFailedException('Tag', $errors);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Every check before a write: the values, the rows they point to, the unique values.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function check(UnitOfWork $uow, array $values, ?Tag $current): void
    {
        self::validate($uow, $values, $current);
    }

    /**
     * Sets the given values on the entity.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $values
     */
    private static function apply(Tag $entity, array $values): void
    {
        if (array_key_exists('label', $values)) {
            $entity->label = $values['label'];
        }
    }

    /** The Tag with this key; NotFoundException when there is none. */
    private static function find(UnitOfWork $uow, int $id): Tag
    {
        return $uow->tags->findById($id) ?? throw new NotFoundException('Tag', $id);
    }

    /** The Tag as services return it. */
    private static function read(Tag $entity): TagRead
    {
        return new TagRead(
            id: $entity->id,
            label: $entity->label,
        );
    }

    /**
     * The values an update gives, by field.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function given(TagUpdate $changes): array
    {
        $values = [];
        if ($changes->label->isPresent) {
            $values['label'] = $changes->label->value;
        }
        return $values;
    }

    /** Stores a new Tag after checking it. */
    public function createTag(TagCreate $data): TagRead
    {
        $values = array_filter([
            'label' => $data->label,
        ], fn (mixed $value) => $value !== null);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($values): TagRead {
            self::check($uow, $values, null);
            $entity = new Tag();
            self::apply($entity, $values);
            return self::read($uow->tags->insert($entity));
        });
    }

    public function getTag(int $id): TagRead
    {
        return self::read(self::find($this->uow, $id));
    }

    public function listTags(int $offset, int $limit): Page
    {
        return $this->uow->tags->list($offset, $limit)->map(self::read(...));
    }

    /** Changes the given values of a Tag. */
    public function updateTag(int $id, TagUpdate $changes): TagRead
    {
        $values = self::given($changes);
        return $this->uow->transaction(function (UnitOfWork $uow) use ($id, $values): TagRead {
            $current = self::find($uow, $id);
            self::check($uow, $values, $current);
            self::apply($current, $values);

        });
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App;

use PDO;
use PDOException;
use PDOStatement;

/** What the repositories run their SQL with, over PDO: statements and their values, and the database's refusals. */
final class Sql
{
    /**
     * Every row of a query, as the list of its columns.
     *
     * @param list<mixed> $values
     * @return list<list<mixed>>
     */
    public static function all(PDO $db, string $sql, array $values = []): array
    {
        return self::run($db, $sql, $values)->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_NUM);
    }

    /**
     * The first row of a query, or null.
     *
     * @param list<mixed> $values
     * @return list<mixed>|null
     */
    public static function one(PDO $db, string $sql, array $values = []): ?array
    {
        return self::all($db, $sql, $values)[0] ?? null;
    }

    /**
     * Runs a statement with its values, in order.
     *
     * @param list<mixed> $values
     */
    public static function run(PDO $db, string $sql, array $values = []): PDOStatement
    {
        $statement = $db->prepare($sql);
        foreach ($values as $index => $value) {
            $statement->bindValue($index + 1, $value, match (true) {
                $value === null => PDO::PARAM_NULL,
                is_int($value) => PDO::PARAM_INT,
                is_bool($value) => PDO::PARAM_BOOL,
                default => PDO::PARAM_STR,
            });
        }
        $statement->execute();
        return $statement;
    }

    /** Whether the database refused a write: a unique value taken, a row still pointed to, a value against its rules. */
    public static function isRefusal(PDOException $error): bool
    {
        // SQLSTATE class 23: integrity constraint violation
        return str_starts_with((string) $error->getCode(), '23');
    }
}

/** The repositories over one PDO connection, and its transaction. */
final class SqlUnitOfWork implements UnitOfWork
{
    public readonly CustomerRepository $customers;
    public readonly CategoryRepository $categories;
    public readonly ProductRepository $products;
    public readonly TagRepository $tags;
    public readonly ProductTagRepository $productTags;

    public function __construct(public readonly PDO $db)

        $this->products = new SqlProductRepository($db);
        $this->tags = new SqlTagRepository($db);
        $this->productTags = new SqlProductTagRepository($db);

    public function transaction(callable $work): mixed
    {
        // Joins the transaction already open
        if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
            return $work($this);
        }
        $this->db->beginTransaction();
        try {
            $result = $work($this);
            $this->db->commit();
            return $result;
        } catch (\Throwable $error) {
            if ($this->db->inTransaction()) {
                $this->db->rollBack();
            }
            throw $error;
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests;

use App\Database;
use App\SqlUnitOfWork;

/** The test database: the PostgreSQL database TEST_DATABASE_URL names, created from the schema before every test. */
final class TestDatabase
{
    /** Removes every table, so the database starts empty */
    private const DROP = [
        'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "product_tags" CASCADE',
        'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "tags" CASCADE',
        'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "products" CASCADE',
        'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "categories" CASCADE',
        'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "customers" CASCADE',
    ];

    /** Creates every table, in an order the database accepts */
    private const CREATE = [
        'CREATE TABLE "customers" (
  "id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "email" VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("email")
)',
        'CREATE TABLE "categories" (
  "id" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "name" VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("name")
)',
        'CREATE TABLE "products" (
  "id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "name" VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  "price" NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
  "status" VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT \'draft\',
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CHECK ("status" IN (\'draft\', \'live\')),
  FOREIGN KEY ("category_id") REFERENCES "categories" ("id")
)',
        'CREATE TABLE "tags" (
  "id" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "label" VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)',
        'CREATE TABLE "product_tags" (
  "product_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,
  "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("product_id", "tag_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("product_id") REFERENCES "products" ("id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("tag_id") REFERENCES "tags" ("id")
)',
    ];

    public static function url(): ?string
    {
        $url = getenv('TEST_DATABASE_URL');
        return is_string($url) && $url !== '' ? $url : null;
    }

    /** The repositories over the test database, with every table dropped and created again. */
    public static function open(): SqlUnitOfWork
    {
        // The tables are written for one kind of database: the tests cannot fall back to SQLite
        $db = Database::open(self::url() ?? throw new \RuntimeException('The database tests need a disposable PostgreSQL database: set TEST_DATABASE_URL (it is emptied)'));
        foreach ([...self::DROP, ...self::CREATE] as $sql) {
            $db->exec($sql);
        }
        return new SqlUnitOfWork($db);
    }
}
